newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade thin at $65 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade thin at $65 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle were lightly tested at $65.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from thin sales Friday and Tuesday, feedlot sources said.

About 600 steers and heifers sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and about 200 heifers sold in Kansas at $65.00. However, sales were too thin to fully test the market, sources in those areas said.
Owners largely resisted attempts to establish a market at the lower level, feedlot sources said.
Some other bids at $65.00 were passed by owners asking $67.00. Last week's top cattle price was $67.00.
